1 unit valas = n IDR: 1 unit of foreign currency = n IDR
1 unit valas = n IDR, per tanggal berlak: 1 unit of foreign currency = n IDR, per effective date
Belum ada mata uang asing aktif. Tambahk: No active foreign currency yet. Add one in the Currencies list.
Kolom kosong diabaikan; kurs yang sudah: Empty fields are ignored; existing rates on that date are updated.
Kode sudah dipakai dan tidak dapat diuba: The code is already in use and cannot be changed.
Dokumen yang sudah dibuat tidak berubah;: Existing documents do not change; the new rate is used by later documents.
mis. kurs tengah BI / kurs pajak (KMK): e.g. BI middle rate / tax rate (KMK)
semua jurnal & laporan dalam Rupiah. Fak: all journals & reports are in Rupiah. Foreign-currency invoices, payments and cash transactions copy the rate of their document date (the latest rate on or before that date), so correcting a rate here does not change documents already created.
Faktur yang dialokasikan harus bermata u: Allocated invoices must be in the same currency.
dihitung dari nilai tercatat rekening va: calculated from the foreign account's carrying value on posting
rekening valas berkurang sebesar nilai t: the foreign account is reduced at its carrying value; the difference goes to FX gain/loss
Transfer antar dua mata uang asing belum: Transfers between two foreign currencies are not supported yet — go through an IDR account.
Rekening valas (mis. USD) memakai akun C: A foreign-currency account (e.g. USD) needs a new, unused COA account; its balance is kept in the original currency and in IDR.
Akun COA dan mata uang tidak dapat digan: The COA account and currency cannot be changed because the account already has transactions.
Tidak ada saldo valas yang perlu direval: There are no foreign-currency balances to revalue on this date.
Saldo {0} tidak ikut direvaluasi karena: {0} balances are not revalued because there is no rate yet. Enter the rate in Currencies & Rates.
Posting revaluasi per {0}? Jurnal revalu: Post the revaluation as of {0}? The revaluation journal and its reversal ({1}) will be created.
PSAK 10 / IAS 21: saldo valas yang masih: PSAK 10 / IAS 21: foreign-currency balances still open at period end — unpaid foreign purchase/sales invoices and foreign cash/bank accounts — are remeasured at the closing rate. The difference is booked to
Jurnalnya dibalik otomatis keesokan hari: Its journal is reversed automatically the next day, so later settlements are still compared with the invoice rate (the difference becomes realized gain/loss).
Jurnal revaluasi dan jurnal pembalik oto: The revaluation journal and its automatic reversal are each reversed on their own date (the periods of {0} and {1} must still be open). The revaluation can then be run again.
